headline: Salesforce CEO says goodbye SEO. Salesforce guide disagrees.
dek: Marc Benioff posted "Goodbye SEO" to promote a new AI visibility tool, while a Salesforce guide linked from that tool page calls SEO the foundation.
why: Clients and bosses will hear "SEO is dead" from big names, while the evidence still says AI visibility rests on crawlable, trusted content.
doThis: Keep a short, sourced answer ready for the next person who asks whether SEO is dead.
